_what: Provenance of every executor fixture. No fixture is a captured agent run: running an agent on a task would spend the user's tokens. 'captured' = real output of the installed binary on this machine; 'documented' = copied verbatim from the official docs; 'constructed' = hand-written to the shape verified in the named source.

opencode.jsonl.source: event writer compiled into opencode.exe 1.18.32: JSON.stringify({type,timestamp,sessionID,...}) with text/step_start/step_finish/tool_use/error; step-finish part {tokens:{input,output,reasoning,cache},cost}

claude.json.source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/headless (result, session_id, total_cost_usd, usage) + Agent SDK result message fields

cline.jsonl.source: cline.exe 3.0.61 compiled source: {type:'agent_event',event} with content_end/usage/done event shapes

gemini.json.source: https://geminicli.com/docs/cli/headless/ (response, stats, error); stats.models.<m>.tokens layout is an assumption, not documented
